Definition
[$C^{k,\alpha }$-closeness of hypersurfaces (Definition K.9)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0356, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0357 ↗ def:chow-iv-k7-holder-spaces 1. appk:K.9\group Function Spaces

A normal graph $\mathcal Y_\varphi $ is $\varepsilon $-close to a hypersurface $\mathcal X$ in $C^{k,\alpha }$ when $\| \varphi \| _{C^{k,\alpha }(\mathcal X)}\le \varepsilon $.
